verification_candidates.claim_text: An optimal gut microbiome can improve vaccine efficacy.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: we know that an optimal gut microbiome can improve vaccine efficacy
verification_candidates.rationale: Whether the gut microbiome measurably improves vaccine response is checkable and bears on the advice to delay vaccines.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Children who have had antibiotics, ear infections or gut issues are more likely to have problems with vaccines.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Kids who have had tons of antibiotics, ear infections, who have gut issues
verification_candidates.rationale: The claim that compromised children have more vaccine reactions can be checked against pediatric adverse-event data.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Many vaccines can stress the mitochondria.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: we know a lot of these vaccines can stress the mitochondria
verification_candidates.rationale: A biological mechanism claim about vaccine effects on mitochondria that parents could act on.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Many vaccines contain aluminum, formaldehyde and other ingredients.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: many of these vaccines will have not just aluminum, but formaldehyde and other ingredients
verification_candidates.rationale: The ingredient composition of childhood vaccines is checkable against package inserts.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Glutathione, vitamin C and Epsom salt baths help clear vaccine ingredients from the body faster.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: I'm making sure they're taking extra glutathione and vitamin C and Epsom salt baths
verification_candidates.rationale: A detox protocol for vaccine ingredients that could be checked against any evidence of clearance from the body.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Spacing out vaccines lets the body mount an effective immune response and return to baseline between shots.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: We allow space in between vaccines for the body to do its thing, hopefully mount an effective immune response
verification_candidates.rationale: The benefit of spacing vaccines is the central claim of the alternative-schedule argument and is checkable.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Exercise before and after vaccines may reduce vaccine adverse reactions and improve vaccine efficacy.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: exercise before and after vaccines may reduce vaccine adverse reactions while improving efficacy
verification_candidates.rationale: A specific behavioral claim about vaccine response that can be checked against trials of exercise and vaccination.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Getting good sleep two nights before vaccination improves vaccine efficacy.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: the sleep two nights before actually improves vaccine efficacy
verification_candidates.rationale: Sleep timing relative to vaccination and its effect on antibody response is a checkable research claim.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Childhood conditions such as allergies, autoimmunity, gut issues, ADD, autism, learning disabilities and depression are all related to each other.
verification_candidates.rationale: A claim of shared cause across many childhood conditions that drives the book's prevention message.
